The Hard Easy (Adventure Time): "The Hard Easy" is the twenty-third episode of the fourth season of the American animated television series "Adventure Time".  The episode was written and storyboarded by Tom Herpich and Skyler Page, from a story by Patrick McHale, Kent Osborne, and Pendleton Ward.  It originally aired on Cartoon Network on October 1, 2012.  The episode guest stars Brian Doyle-Murray as Prince Huge and Jonathan Katz as the Mudscamp elder.
